descriptionByLocale.it:
Nell’ambito del nostro dipartimento “Svizzera & Affari Internazionali” di Corporate Security, supporta il Chief Security Officer (CSO) in modo amministrativo e coordinato nelle attività quotidiane. Aiutano a progettare i processi in modo efficiente e a garantire i processi organizzativi nel reparto professionalmente. Le loro attività includono in particolare:
• Supporto amministrativo e di coordinamento del CSO e del dipartimento
• Pianificazione, priorità e monitoraggio dei compiti, scadenze, misure e open item
• Gestione amministrativa dei processi definiti
• Organizzazione e preparazione e follow-up di incontri ed eventi
• Gestione delle informazioni e dei documenti
• Punto di contatto centrale per le indagini di gruppo e la loro allocazione strutturata

• Studi completi (ad esempio amministrazione aziendale, amministrazione, gestione della sicurezza o simili) o esperienza professionale comparabile in un ruolo amministrativo
• Esperienza nei processi amministrativi, idealmente in un ambiente internazionale e di sicurezza
• Molto buone capacità organizzative e un modo di lavoro previsionale e affidabile
• Gestione sicura di MS Office (specialmente Word, Excel e PowerPoint)
• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese (in parola e scrittura), altre lingue sono un plus
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con progetti emozionanti
• Ore lavorative flessibili (ore lavorative attive e affidabili)
• Prestazioni sociali molto buone e un fondo pensione superobbligatorio
• Vantaggi dei dipendenti di una grande società, programma di acquisto azionario dei dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.en:
As part of our “Switzerland & International Affairs” department of Corporate Security, you support the Chief Security Officer (CSO) administratively and coordinatively in day-to-day business. They help to design processes efficiently and to ensure the organizational processes in the department professionally. Their activities include in particular:
• Administrative and coordination support of the CSO and in the department
• Predictive planning, prioritization and tracking of tasks, deadlines, measures and open items
• Administrative management of defined processes
• Organization and preparation and follow-up of meetings and events
• Information and document management
• Central contact point for group-wide inquiries and their structured allocation
• Support in planning and tracking activities on security-related topics (object, travel, expat and foreign security, know-how protection, emergency and crisis management, etc.) What you should bring with you
• Completed studies (e.g. business administration, administration, security management or similar) or comparable professional experience in an administrative role
• Experience in administrative processes, ideally in an international and security-relevant environment
• Very good organizational skills and a forward-looking, reliable way of working
• Secure handling of MS Office (especially Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
• Very good communication skills in German and English (in word and writing), other languages are a plus WHAT WE ARE TO YOU
• A dynamic working environment with exciting projects
• Flexible working hours (active and trusted working hours)
• Very good social benefits and a super-compulsory pension fund
• Employee benefits of a large corporation, employee share purchase program
• Promotion of needs-based training
• Staff restaurant and external catering and shopping facilities nearby
• Individual internal and external personnel development measures in cooperation with our Rheinmetall Academy
• Workplace a few minutes walk from the Zurich-Oerlikon train station KONTAKTDETAILS Responsible contact: Melanie Huellen For questions about your application, please use the contact form. Please note that dossiers of recruiters are not considered.

You lead a team of five employees. Specifically, you take on the following tasks:
• Creation of a freight forwarding concept (import/export)
• Preparation and enforcement of guidelines for a requirement-compliant forwarding company
• Execution of forwarding orders, providing capacity and documents for handling
• Ensuring packaging quality and safety
• Function as a specialist for forwarding and approval logistics in project organisations
• Cooperation with clients, shippers, authorities and forwarders
• Advice, implementation and compliance with technical regulations
• Development of export data (MAC) in cooperation with internal specialist departments
• Management of import, export and transit authorisations as well as the handling of import obligations in cooperation with customs authorities WHAT YOU SHOULD BUILD
• Commercial education and training completed (foreign trade manager, foreign trade specialist (m/f/d) or similar)
